Flow is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2018 to 2018.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [bcnode-old](@/work/bcnode-old.md): Mining node with built-in block rover and DHT.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Flow: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Flow to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
